description: Stereo phaser: a chain of swept allpass or notch filters, with a feedback loop and a wet/dry blend.

params.text: Steps the filter chain through 4, 8 and 12 stages; more stages put more notches in the sweep.
Switches the stages between allpass, marked AP, and notch, marked NR.
Steps the sweep waveform through sine, triangle, sawtooth and square.
Sets the sweep rate, marked in Hz, from about 0.004Hz to 8Hz.
Sets how far the notches travel from their resting frequencies, 0 to 100%.
Steps through four notch spacings: logarithmic, constant, and those two again with alternate notches moving the opposite way.
Sends the filtered signal back into the input, -100% to 100%; negative amounts return it inverted.
Sets the frequency the notches are spread around, marked in Hz, from 16Hz to 16384Hz.
Sets how far apart the notches are spread; 100% spreads them over about four octaves.
Sets the Q of every filter stage, 0.5 to 5; the default is 0.707 and higher values sharpen the notches.
Offsets the right channel sweep from the left, 0 to 360 degrees; the default is 90 degrees.
Blends the dry input with the filtered signal, 0 to 100% filtered.

inputs.text: The left input signal; with nothing patched to the right input, this one feeds both channels.
The right input signal; leaving this unpatched sends the left input to both channels.
Takes a signal into the feedback loop for that channel in place of the module's own filtered signal.
Adds to the sweep rate at a volt per octave, so 1V doubles the rate set by the knob.
Adds to the travel of the notches, 0-10V covering the full range.
Adds to the feedback amount, 10V covering the full positive range.
Adds to the frequency the notches are spread around, at a volt per octave.
Adds to the spread of the notches, 0-10V covering the full range.
Adds to the Q of the filter stages, 2V covering the full range.
Adds to the right channel sweep offset, 0-10V covering the full 360 degrees.
Replaces the internal sweep waveform for that channel; 0-10V covers the whole travel of the notches.
Adds to the wet/dry blend, 10V covering the full range.

outputs.text: The filtered signal for that channel before the wet/dry blend, for running effects inside the feedback loop.
Carries that channel of the dry and filtered signals blended by MIX.

inputs.4: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.7: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
